name: app.R
README.md
content:
# Longitudinal study-design diagram builder

## Files

```
app.R                 UI + server (Shiny) — single file, CSS/JS inline as in the original
make-diagram.R        gen_long_diag(): builds the ggplot from two data frames
helpers.R             shared constants + pure helper functions (no shiny/ggplot2)
tests/test-helpers.R   smoke tests for helpers.R, run with: Rscript tests/test-helpers.R
```

Run the app as usual from the folder containing `app.R` (e.g. `shiny::runApp()` or
the "Run App" button in RStudio).

## What changed since the first pass

Two things were broken and are now fixed:

- **CSS/JS had moved to a `www/` folder**, referenced via `href="styles.css"` /
  `src="app.js"`. That's a real Shiny pattern, but it depends on the `www/`
  folder being placed exactly right next to `app.R`, and it wasn't loading —
  which is exactly why the second-order anchor rows and the Output tab
  rendered as an unstyled, vertically-stacked list (the flexbox layout lives
  entirely in that stylesheet). Reverted to inlining the CSS/JS directly in
  `app.R` via `tags$style(HTML(...))` / `tags$script(HTML(...))`, matching
  the original single-file app exactly — no separate folder to get wrong.

- **The overlap-highlight layer** was added to the plot conditionally
  (`if (nrow(overlap_df) > 0) geom_rect(...)`, relying on `ggplot + NULL`
  being a no-op when there's nothing to highlight). I can't run
  shiny/ggplot2 in my sandbox to confirm that behaves the way I expect on
  your installed version, so I replaced it with a `geom_rect()` that's
  always added — drawing a zero-row data frame is unambiguously a no-op in
  ggplot2, so this removes that risk entirely regardless of version.

If the plot still doesn't render after these, please paste the actual error
text from the R console (not just the browser) — "errors loading packages"
could be a real problem with one of `svglite`/`textshaping`/`ggfittext` in
your R environment, which I have no way to reproduce or diagnose without
seeing the message, and which the app's `library(...)` calls are unchanged
from your original file.

## Everything else from the first pass, unchanged

- `box_colors`, anchor choice lists, and legacy numeric-color handling now
  live once in `helpers.R` as `resolve_box_color()`, instead of being
  duplicated in `app.R` and `make-diagram.R`.
- Both "First-order anchors" and "Second-order anchors" tabs have a small
  "✕" delete button on each row (replacing the old "Remove anchor"
  remove-last button on both tabs).
- First-order anchors are drawn with width scaled to the plotted time range,
  and any second-order window whose drawn extent includes that day gets a
  highlighted overlap marker.
- Row/anchor bookkeeping uses an ever-increasing id counter + a vector of
  active ids, and ids are never reused within a session (including after
  loading a saved project).
- Fixed an id collision between the first-order anchor row's wrapper `<div>`
  and its "Index date" numeric input (both were `index{n}`).
- Fixed the PDF/SVG export ignoring the "Aspect ratio" (4:3 / 16:9) setting;
  the on-screen preview now matches it too.
- Removed a dead `observeEvent(input$restore_state, ...)` block nothing ever
  triggered, and a duplicated `x_range` calculation that silently overwrote
  itself with a different value partway through `gen_long_diag()`.

name: helpers.R
content:
# helpers.R
#
# Shared constants and pure helper functions used by both app.R and
# make-diagram.R. Nothing here depends on shiny or ggplot2, so it can be
# sourced and unit-tested on its own (see tests/test-helpers.R).

# A handful of R versions still lack the base `%||%` operator (only added
# to base R in 4.4.0). Define it defensively so the app doesn't rely on it
# being re-exported by one of the plotting packages.
if (!exists("%||%")) {
  `%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

# First-order anchor choices (index dates, e.g. cohort entry / event date)
anchor1_choices <- c(
  "Cohort entry date" = "Cohort entry date",
  "Event date"        = "Event date"
)

# Second-order anchor choices (interval / window labels)
anchor2_choices <- c(
  "Please choose" = "",
  "Follow-up"     = "Follow-up window",
  "Eligibility"   = "Eligibility assessment window",
  "Exclusion"     = "Exclusion assessment window",
  "Covariates"    = "Covariate assessment window",
  "Washout"       = "Washout window",
  "Exposure"      = "Exposure assessment window"
)

# Box color palette. All colors are dark enough for white text on top.
box_colors <- c(
  "Blue"     = "#0b5e92",
  "Teal"     = "#1b947a",
  "Green"    = "#1d811d",
  "Purple"   = "#64309b",
  "Plum"     = "#5f1848",
  "Orange"   = "#c46a1c",
  "Brown"    = "#8f6949",
  "Red"      = "#A23E3E",
  "Slate"    = "#4D5963"
)

#' Resolve a stored color value to a valid hex code.
#'
#' Handles saved project files from any generation of the app:
#'   - current:      a hex code straight out of `box_colors` (e.g. "#0b5e92")
#'   - legacy:        a numeric index into a fixed palette (e.g. "3")
#'   - unknown/blank: falls back to the first palette color
#'
#' @param value   a single stored color value (character or numeric)
#' @param palette named vector of hex colors, defaults to `box_colors`
#' @return a single hex color string, always present in `palette`
resolve_box_color <- function(value, palette = box_colors) {
  value <- as.character(value %||% palette[[1]])

  if (grepl("^[0-9]+$", value)) {
    idx <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(value))
    if (!is.na(idx) && idx >= 1 && idx <= length(palette)) {
      return(unname(palette[[idx]]))
    }
    return(unname(palette[[1]]))
  }

  if (value %in% unname(palette)) {
    return(value)
  }

  unname(palette[[1]])
}

name: make-diagram.R
content:
# make-diagram.R
#
# Builds the longitudinal study-design ggplot from two data frames:
#   plt     - one row per second-order anchor (interval / window box)
#   indices - one row per first-order anchor (index date / vertical line)

source("helpers.R")

gen_long_diag <- function(
  plt,
  indices,
  txt_size = 14,
  addpad = 0,
  xlim_min,
  xlim_max,
  hide_x_labels = FALSE,
  hide_index_dates = FALSE
) {
  # --- Color handling (current hex values and legacy numeric indices) -----

  plt$color <- vapply(plt$color, resolve_box_color, character(1))

  # Backward compatibility if columns are absent from an older saved project
  if (is.null(plt$end_inf))  plt$end_inf  <- FALSE
  if (is.null(plt$days_lbl)) plt$days_lbl <- ""

  plt$end_inf[is.na(plt$end_inf)]   <- FALSE
  plt$days_lbl[is.na(plt$days_lbl)] <- ""

  # Label indefinite ends before the generic lbl-filling below overwrites them
  plt$end_lbl[plt$end_inf & plt$end_lbl == ""] <- "\u221e"  # infinity symbol
  plt$end[plt$end_inf] <- Inf

  # --- X coordinates for interval boxes ------------------------------------

  plt$minx <- plt$start
  plt$minx[!is.finite(plt$minx)] <- min(plt$minx[is.finite(plt$minx)])

  plt$maxx <- plt$end
  x_max_finite <- max(plt$maxx[is.finite(plt$maxx)])
  x_min_finite <- min(plt$minx[is.finite(plt$minx)])

  # Axis limits, computed first so infinite boxes can be clipped exactly to them
  x_left  <- if (!is.na(xlim_min)) xlim_min else x_min_finite - addpad
  x_right <- if (!is.na(xlim_max)) xlim_max else x_max_finite + addpad
  x_range <- x_right - x_left

  # Infinite boxes extend exactly to the right axis edge
  plt$maxx[plt$end_inf] <- x_right

  # Zero-length intervals: give them a small visible width
  lwdth <- 0.8
  zero_len <- is.finite(plt$end) & (plt$end - plt$start == 0)
  plt$minx[zero_len] <- plt$start[zero_len] - lwdth
  plt$maxx[zero_len] <- plt$start[zero_len] + lwdth

  # Intervals touching time zero: extend slightly past the axis line
  plt$maxx[is.finite(plt$end)   & plt$end   == 0] <-  lwdth
  plt$minx[is.finite(plt$start) & plt$start == 0] <- -lwdth

  # Label x position: center of box
  plt$lblx <- plt$minx + abs(plt$maxx - plt$minx) / 2

  # --- Interval labels ------------------------------------------------------

  plt$start_lbl[plt$start_lbl == ""] <- as.character(plt$start[plt$start_lbl == ""])
  plt$end_lbl[plt$end_lbl == ""]     <- as.character(plt$end[plt$end_lbl == ""])

  default_days_lbl <- paste0("Days [", plt$start_lbl, ";", plt$end_lbl, "]")
  final_days_lbl <- ifelse(nzchar(trimws(plt$days_lbl)), plt$days_lbl, default_days_lbl)

  plt$lbl2[plt$lbl2 != ""] <- paste0("\n", plt$lbl2[plt$lbl2 != ""])
  plt$lbl <- paste0(plt$lbl, plt$lbl2, "\n", final_days_lbl)

  # --- Index date (first-order anchor) labels -------------------------------

  indices$indexlabel2[indices$indexlabel2 != ""] <- paste0("\n", indices$indexlabel2[indices$indexlabel2 != ""])

  if (isTRUE(hide_index_dates)) {
    indices$indexlabel <- paste0(indices$indexlabel, indices$indexlabel2)
  } else {
    indices$indexlabel <- paste0(indices$indexlabel, indices$indexlabel2, "\nDay ", indices$vlines)
  }

  # --- Split into inside-box and outside-box label sets ---------------------

  plt_big <- plt[plt$outside_box == 0, ]
  plt_sml <- plt[plt$outside_box > 0,  ]

  abs_nudge <- max(floor(x_range / 100), 2)

  plt_sml_l <- plt_sml[plt_sml$outside_box == 1, ]
  plt_sml_r <- plt_sml[plt_sml$outside_box == 2, ]

  plt_sml_l$lbl_x <- plt_sml_l$start - abs_nudge
  plt_sml_r$lbl_x <- plt_sml_r$end   + abs_nudge

  lbl_size     <- (txt_size / ggplot2::.pt)
  idx_lbl_size <- (txt_size / (14 / 5)) + 0.25

  # --- First-order anchor band width ----------------------------------------
  #
  # The anchor band gets a small width (scaled to the plotted x-range, so it
  # stays visible whether the diagram spans 10 days or 10 years) instead of a
  # fixed number of days.

  anchor_halfwidth <- max(x_range * 0.006, 1)

  # Where a box's interval reaches a first-order anchor day, widen its drawn
  # *fill* extent to at least the anchor's own width, so the box's color
  # completely covers the anchor there - no sliver of the anchor band left
  # poking out, and (being fully opaque, see below) no bleed-through tint
  # either. Only the fill rectangle is widened: label/text positions still
  # use the box's own original extent, so text stays centered correctly.
  plt$fill_minx <- plt$minx
  plt$fill_maxx <- plt$maxx

  for (a in indices$vlines) {
    touches <- (plt$maxx > a - anchor_halfwidth) & (plt$minx < a + anchor_halfwidth)
    plt$fill_minx[touches] <- pmin(plt$fill_minx[touches], a - anchor_halfwidth)
    plt$fill_maxx[touches] <- pmax(plt$fill_maxx[touches], a + anchor_halfwidth)
  }

  # --- Index label staggering (avoid overlapping labels at the top) --------

  char_frac    <- 0.01
  stagger_step <- idx_lbl_size * 0.08
  base_y       <- max(plt$line) + 0.1

  indices <- indices[order(indices$vlines), , drop = FALSE]
  n <- nrow(indices)

  if (n <= 1) {
    indices$lbl_y <- base_y
  } else {
    label_main <- sub("\n.*", "", indices$indexlabel)
    half_w <- nchar(label_main) * char_frac * x_range * txt_size / 20

    stagger <- numeric(n)
    for (i in 2:n) {
      for (j in seq_len(i - 1)) {
        overlap <- abs(indices$vlines[i] - indices$vlines[j]) < (half_w[i] + half_w[j])
        if (overlap) {
          stagger[i] <- max(stagger[i], stagger[j] + stagger_step)
        }
      }
    }
    indices$lbl_y <- base_y + stagger
  }

  # --- Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------

  ggplot(
    plt,
    aes(
      x     = lblx,
      y     = line - 0.45,
      xmin  = minx,
      xmax  = maxx,
      ymin  = line - 0.9,
      ymax  = line,
      label = lbl
    )
  ) +
    # First-order anchor bands (index dates), drawn underneath the boxes
    geom_rect(
      data = indices,
      aes(xmin = vlines - anchor_halfwidth, xmax = vlines + anchor_halfwidth, ymin = 0, ymax = max(plt$line)),
      fill = "grey60",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # Interval boxes, drawn on top and fully opaque (so nothing bleeds
    # through from the anchor band below), widened via fill_minx/fill_maxx
    # where needed so the box's own color fully covers any anchor it touches
    geom_rect(
      aes(xmin = fill_minx, xmax = fill_maxx),
      fill = plt$color, alpha = 1
    ) +
    # Text inside boxes
    ggfittext::geom_fit_text(
      data     = plt_big,
      color    = "white",
      size     = txt_size,
      fontface = "bold",
      reflow   = TRUE,
      grow     = FALSE
    ) +
    # Text outside boxes - left
    geom_text(
      data  = plt_sml_l,
      aes(x = lbl_x, y = line - 0.45, label = lbl),
      hjust       = 1,
      color       = plt_sml_l$color,
      size        = lbl_size,
      fontface    = "bold",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # Text outside boxes - right
    geom_text(
      data  = plt_sml_r,
      aes(x = lbl_x, y = line - 0.45, label = lbl),
      hjust       = 0,
      color       = plt_sml_r$color,
      size        = lbl_size,
      fontface    = "bold",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # Index date labels at top
    geom_label(
      data = indices,
      aes(x = vlines, y = lbl_y, label = indexlabel),
      vjust         = "bottom",
      hjust         = ifelse(max(plt$end, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0, "right", "center"),
      fontface      = "bold",
      size          = idx_lbl_size,
      color         = "grey60",
      label.r       = unit(0, "lines"),
      linewidth     = 0,
      label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"),
      inherit.aes   = FALSE
    ) +
    xlab("Time (days)") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      limits = c(x_left, x_right),
      breaks = function(x) {
        b <- scales::breaks_pretty()(x)
        b[b < x_right]
      }
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      limits = c(0, max(indices$lbl_y) + ifelse(any(grepl("\n", indices$indexlabel)), 1, 0.5))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      axis.line.x = element_line(arrow = arrow(length = unit(8, "pt"), type = "closed")),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if (isTRUE(hide_x_labels)) element_blank() else element_text(face = "bold", size = txt_size),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = txt_size),

      axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
}

name: tests/test-helpers.R
content:
# tests/test-helpers.R
#
# Minimal smoke tests for the pure functions in helpers.R. These deliberately
# avoid testthat/shiny/ggplot2 so they can run with plain `Rscript` and no
# extra installed packages.
#
# Run with:  Rscript tests/test-helpers.R

this_file <- function() {
  args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
  file_arg <- grep("^--file=", args, value = TRUE)
  if (length(file_arg)) sub("^--file=", "", file_arg[1]) else NULL
}

script_dir <- {
  f <- this_file()
  if (!is.null(f)) dirname(normalizePath(f)) else getwd()
}

source(file.path(dirname(script_dir), "helpers.R"))

# --- resolve_box_color -------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(resolve_box_color("#1b947a") == "#1b947a")          # already valid hex
stopifnot(resolve_box_color("3") == unname(box_colors[[3]]))   # legacy numeric index
stopifnot(resolve_box_color(3) == unname(box_colors[[3]]))      # legacy numeric (not character)
stopifnot(resolve_box_color("not-a-color") == unname(box_colors[[1]])) # unknown -> fallback
stopifnot(resolve_box_color(NULL) == unname(box_colors[[1]]))   # missing -> fallback
stopifnot(resolve_box_color("999") == unname(box_colors[[1]]))  # out-of-range index -> fallback

cat("All helper tests passed.\n")
